a: Mikkan amru chachamim: yafa shetika lachachamim, kal vachomer lattippeshim. shenneemar: "evil macharish chacham yechashev".

Shenayim shennitarvu pischehem vechulei. lema matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda. detanya: "veim yimat habbayit mihyot misse", melammed shemmitmaatin veholchin, uvilvad sheyyehe echad mibbene chavura kayyaym, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: uvilvad shello yannichu et happesach kemot shehu!
Amar rabbi yochanan: afillu tema rabbi yehuda, kevan deamar rabbi yehuda en shochatin et happesach al hayyachid, meikkara leamnoye acharina bahadeh kae, ucheechad mibbene chavura dame.

Amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayyka, dekatane: vechen chamesh chavurot shel chamishsha chamishsha. shel chamishsha — in, aval shel chamishsha vearbaa — la, lav mishshum dela payesh chad mibbene chavura gabbeh? shema minna.
Haderan alach mi shehaya tame uselika la pesach sheni
b: Mishna erev pesachim samuch lammincha lo yochal adam ad shettechshach. afillu ani shebbeyisrael lo yochal ad sheyyasev, velo yifchatu lo mearba kosot shel yayin vaafillu min hattamchuy.

Gemara may irya arve fesachim? afillu arve shabbatot veyamim tovim name. detanya: lo yochal adam bearve shabbatot veyamim tovim min hammincha ulemala kede sheyyikkanes lashshabbat keshehu taava, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: ochel veholech ad shettechshach.
Amar rav huna: la tzericha ella lerabbi yose, deamar: ochel veholech ad shettechshach — hane mille bearve shabbatot veyamim tovim, aval beerev happesach, mishshum chiyyuva dematztza mode.
Rav pappa amar: afillu tema rabbi yehuda, hatam bearve shabbatot veyamim tovim min hammincha ulemala hu daasir, samuch lammincha shere. aval beerev happesach, afillu samuch lammincha name asur.

Uvaerev shabbat samuch lammincha shere? vehatanya: lo yochal adam beerev shabbat veyamim tovim mittesha shaot ulemala, kede sheyyikkanes lashshabbat keshehu taava, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: ochel veholech ad shettechshach.
Amar mar zutera: man lema lan dimtaratzta hi?

a: Dilma meshabbashta hi.
Amar leh marimar, veittema rav yemar: ana ikkelai lefirkeh derav pinchas bereh derav amme, vekam tanna vetane kammeh vekaybla minneh. i hachi kashya! ella mechavvavrta kidrav huna.

Ulerav huna mi nicha? vehaamar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi yochanan, veittema amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yose bar rabbi chanina: halacha kerabbi yehuda beerev happesach, vahalacha kerabbi yose beerev shabbat.
Halacha kerabbi yehuda beerev happesach, mikkelal diflig rabbi yose betarvayyhu!
La: halacha, mikkelal difligi behafesaka.
Detanya: mafsikin leshabbatot, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: en mafsikin.

Umaase berabban shimon ben gamliel [verabbi yehuda] verabbi yose shehayu mesubbin beakko vekiddesh alehem hayyom, amar leh rabban shimon ben gamliel lerabbi yose: berabbi, retzoncha nafsik venechush ledivre yehuda chaverenu?
Amar lo: bechol yom veyom atta mechabbev devarayy lifne rabbi yehuda, veachshav atta mechabbev divre rabbi yehuda befanay? "hagam lichbosh et hammalka immi babbayit".
Amar leh: im ken lo nafsik, shemma yiru hattalmidim veyikbeu halacha ledorot. amru: lo zazu mishsham ad shekkavu halacha kerabbi yose.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: en halacha lo kerabbi yehuda velo kerabbi yose, ella pores mappa umekaddesh. ini?! veha amar rav tachlifa bar avdimi amar shemuel: keshem shemmafsikin lekiddush
b: Kach mafsikin lahavedala. may mafsikin — lav laakirat shulechan? la, lemappa.

Rabba bar rav huna ikkela leve resh galuta, ayyto takka kammeh, peras mappa vekaydesh. tanya name hachi: (veshavin) sheen meviin et hashshulechan ella im ken kiddesh, veim hevi — pores mappa umekaddesh.
Tane chada: shavin sheen matchilin, vetanya iddach: shavin shemmatchilin. bishlama ha detanya shavin sheen matchilin — mashkachat la beerev happesach,
Ella ha detanya shavin shemmatchilin — emat? i nema beerev shabbat — ha miflag peligi! la kashya: kan — kodem tisha, kan — leachar tisha.
Otam bene adam shekkiddeshu bevet hakkeneset, amar rav: yede yayin lo yatzu, yede kiddush yatzu. ushemuel amar:

a: Af yede kiddush lo yatzu. ella lerav, lema leh lekaddoshe beveteh? kede lehotzi banav uvene veto.
Ushemuel, lema li lekaddoshe beve chenishta? leappoke orchim yede chovatan, deachlu veshatu veganu beve chenishta.
Veazda shemuel letameh, deamar shemuel: en kiddush ella bimkom seuda. sevur minna: hane mille mibbayit levayit, aval mimmakom lemakom bechad beta — la.
Amar lehu rav anan bar tachlifa: zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh dishmuel, venachet meiggara leara vahadar mekaddesh.

Veaf rav huna savar en kiddush ella bimkom seuda. derav huna kaddesh, veitakara leh sheraga, veayyayli leh lemaneh leve genaneh derabba bereh dahava sheraga vekaddesh uteem midde, alma kasavar: en kiddush ella bimkom seuda.

Veaf rabba savar en kiddush ella bimkom seuda. daamar abbaye: ki havena be mar, ki hava mekaddesh amar lan: teimu midde, dilma addeazlitu leushepiza mitakra lechu sheraga vela mekaddesh lechu bevet achila, uvekiddusha dehacha la nafkitu, deen kiddush ella bimkom seuda.
Ini?! vehaamar abbaye: kol mille demar hava aved kerav, levar mehane telat deaved kishmuel: mattirin mibbeged leveged. umadlikin minner lener. vahalacha kerabbi shimon bigrira.
Detanya, rabbi shimon omer: gorer adam mitta kisse vesafsal bashshabbat, uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot charitz.
Kechumere derav hava aved, kekulle derav la hava avid.
Verabbi yochanan amar: af yede yayin name yatzu. veazda rabbi yochanan letameh, deamar rabbi chanin bar abbaye amar rabbi pedat amar rabbi yochanan: echad shinnuy yayin,
b: Veechad shinnuy makom — en tzarich levarech. metivi: shinnuy makom tzarich levarech, shinnuy yayin en tzarich levarech, teyuveta derabbi yochanan teyuveta.
Yatev rav idi bar avin kammeh derav chisda, veyatev rav chisda vekaamar mishshemeh derav huna: ha deamrat shinnuy makom tzarich levarech, lo shanu ella mibbayit levayit, aval mimmakom lemakom — la.
Amar leh rav idi bar avin: hachi tenena leh bematnita deve rav henak, veamri leh bematnita deve bar henak kevotaych. veella rav huna matnita ka mashma lan? rav huna matnita la shemia leh.
Vetu, yatev rav chisda vekaamar mishshemeh denafsheh: ha deamrat shinnuy makom tzarich levarech, la amaran ella bidvarim sheen teunin beracha leacharehen bimkoman,
Aval devarim hatteunin beracha leacharehen bimkoman — en tzarich levarech. may tama, lekiva kamma hadar. verav sheshet amar: echad ze veechad ze tzarich levarech.
Metivi: bene chavura shehayu mesubbin lishtot, veakru raglehen latzet likrat chatan o likrat kalla, keshehen yotzin — en teunin beracha lemafrea, keshehen chozrin — en teunin beracha lechattechilla.
Bamme devarim amurim shehinnichu sham zaken o chole, aval lo hinnichu sham lo zaken velo chole, keshehen yotzin — teunin beracha lemafrea, keshehen chozrin — teunin beracha lechattechilla.

Middekatane akru raglehen, mikkelal devidvarim hatteunin beracha leacharehen bimkoman askinan, vetama dehinnichu sham zaken o chole hu dichshehen yotzin en teunin beracha lemafrea ucheshehen chozrin en teunin beracha lechattechilla,
Aval lo hinnichu sham zaken o chole, keshehen yotzin — teunin beracha lemafrea, ucheshehen chozrin — teunin beracha lechattechilla, kashya lerav chisda!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak:

a: Man tanna akirot,

Rabbi yehuda, detanya: chaverim shehayu mesubbin, veakru raglehem lelech levet hakkeneset o levet hammidrash, keshehen yotzin — en teunin beracha lemafrea, ucheshehen chozrin — en teunin beracha lechattechilla. amar rabbi yehuda: bamme devarim amurim — bizman shehinnichu sham miktzat chaverim, aval lo hinnichu sham miktzat chaverim, keshehen yotzin — teunin beracha lemafrea, ucheshehen chozrin — teunin beracha lechattechilla.

Ella tama devidvarim hatteunin beracha leacharehen bimkoman, dichshehen yotzin — en teunin beracha lemafrea, ucheshehen chozrin — en teunin beracha lechattechilla. aval devarim sheen teunin beracha leacharehen bimkoman, afillu lerabbanan, keshehen yotzin — teunin beracha lemafrea, ucheshehen chozrin — teunin beracha lechattechilla,
Lema tehve teyuveta derabbi yochanan! velav mi otvinneh chada zimna! nema meha name tehve teyuveta!
Amar lach rabbi yochanan: hu haddin daafillu devarim sheen teunin beracha leacharehem bimkoman name en tzerichin levarech, veha dekatane "akru raglehen", lehodiacha kocho derabbi yehuda,

Daafillu devarim shetteunin beracha leacharehen bimkoman, tama dehinnichu miktzat chaverim, aval lo hinnichu miktzat chaverim, keshehen yotzin — teunin beracha lemafrea, ucheshehen chozrin — teunin beracha lechattechilla.
Tanya kevoteh derav chisda: chaverim shehayu mesubbin lishtot yayin, veakru raglehen vechazru — en tzerichin levarech.

Tanu rabbanan: bene chavura shehayu mesubbin vekiddesh alehen hayyom — meviin lo kos shel yayin veomer alav kedushshat hayyom, vesheni omer alav birkat hammazon, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: ochel veholech ad shettechshach.
b: Gamru, kos rishon mevarech alav birkat hammazon vehashsheni omer alav kedushshat hayyom. ammay? venemrinhu letarvayyhu achada kasa!
Amar rav huna amar rav sheshet: en omrim shete kedushshot al kos echad. may tama? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lefi sheen osin mitzvot chavilot chavilot.

Vela? veha tanya: hannichnas leveto bemotzae shabbat mevarech al hayyayin veal hammaor veal habbesamim, veachar kach omer havedala al hakkos. veim en lo ella kos echad — mannicho leachar hammazon umeshalshelan kullan leacharav. en lo shane.
Veha yom tov shechal lihyot achar hashshabbat, deit leh, veamar rav yakne!
Amri: middela amar zeman, mikkelal devishvii shel pesach askinan, dechol may dahava leh achel leh, velet leh.
Veha yom tov rishon deit leh, veamar abbaye: yakzena, verava amar: yaknehaz.
Ella: havedala vekiddush chada milleta hi, birkat hammazon vekiddush tere mille ninhu.
Gufa. yom tov shechal lihyot achar hashshabbat, rav amar: yakne. ushemuel amar: yinhak.

a: Verabba amar: yahnek. velevi amar: keniyya. verabbanan amri: kina. mar bereh deravna amar: nekiyya. marta amar mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua: nihak.

Shelach leh avu dishmuel lerabbi: yelammedenu rabbenu, seder havedalot heach. shelach leh: kach amar rabbi yishmael bar rabbi yose sheamar mishshum aviv sheamar mishshum rabbi yehoshua ben chananya: nehik.
Amar rabbi chanina: mashal derabbi yehoshua ben chananya lemelech sheyyotze veipparchos nichnas, melavvivyn et hammelech veachar kach yotzim likrat ipparchos.
May have ala? abbaye amar: yakzena, verava amar: yaknehaz, vehilcheta kerava.
Rav huna bar yehuda ikkela leve rava, ayyto lekammayyhu maor uvesamim. barech rava abbesamim beresha vahadar ammaor. amar leh: veha ben bet shammay uven bet hillel — maor beresha vahadar abbesamim.
Umay hi? ditnan, bet shammay omrim: ner umazon, besamim vehavedala. uvet hillel omrim: ner uvesamim, umazon vehavedala.
Ane rava batreh veamar: zo divre rabbi meir, aval rabbi yehuda omer: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al hammazon shehu battechilla veal havedala shehi bassof,

Al ma nechleku? al hammaor veal habbesamim. bet shammay omrim: maor veachar kach besamim, uvet hillel omrim: besamim veachar kach maor. veamar rabbi yochanan: nahagu haam kevet hillel veallibba derabbi yehuda.

Rav yaakov bar abba ikkela leve rava, chazye devarech "bore peri haggefen" akkasa kamma, vahadar barech akkasa devirketa, veishti. amar leh: lema lach kulle hay? ha barech lan mar chada zimna! amar leh: ki havenan be resh galuta hachi avdinan.

Amar leh: tinach be resh galuta dehachi aved, desafek mayyte lan safek la mayyte lan. hacha, ha mannach kasa kamman vedatan illaveh? amar leh: ana avadi ketalmide derav, derav berona verav chananel talmide derav havo yatvi bisodta
b: Kae alayyhu rav yeva sava. amaru leh: hav lan venivarech. lesof amaru leh: hav lan venishte, amar lehu: hachi amar rav, kevan deamritu hav lan venivarech, ittasra lechu lemishte. may tama, deaschitu datayychu.

Ammemar umar zutera verav ashe havo yatvi bisuda, vekae alayyhu rav acha bereh derava. ammemar barech al kol kasa vechasa, umar zutera barech akkasa kamma veakkasa batra, rav ashe barech akkasa kamma, vetu la barech.
Amar lehu rav acha bar rava: anan keman naaved? ammemar amar: nimlach ana. mar zutera amar: ana daavadi ketalmide derav.
Verav ashe amar: let hilcheta ketalmide derav, deha yom tov shechal lihyot achar hashshabbat, veamar rav: yakne.
Vela hi, hatam — akar dateh mimmishteya, hacha — la akar dateh mimmishteya.

Ki meta leavdole, kam shammaeh veadlek avuka mishsheraga. amar leh: lema lach kulle hay, ha mancha sheraga! amar leh: shammaa middateh denafsheh ka aved. amar leh: i la shemia leh minneh demar, la hava aved! amar leh: la savar leh mar avuka lehavedala mitzva min hammuvechar.

Patach veamar: "hammavdil ben kodesh lechol ben or lechoshech ben yisrael laammim ben yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase" amar leh: lema lach kulle hay? vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav: "hammavdil ben kodesh lechol" zo hi havedalato shel rabbi yehuda hannasi?
Amar leh: ana keha sevira li, deamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: happochet lo yifchot mishshalosh, vehammosif lo yosif al sheva. amar leh:

a: Veha mar la telata amar vela sheva amar! amar leh: ivra "ben yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase", meen chatima hi, veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hammavdil tzarich sheyyomar meen chatima samuch lachatimato. ufumebditae amri meen petichatan samuch lachatimatan.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu yom tov shechal lihyot achar hashshabbat, dechatminan "ben kodesh lekodesh",

Man deamar meen petichatan samuch lachatimatan, la bae lememar "ben kedushshat shabbat likdushshat yom tov hivdalta". uman deamar meen chatimatan samuch lachatimatan, bae lememar "ben kedushshat shabbat likdushshat yom tov hivdalta".
Gufa. amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: happochet — lo yifchot mishshalosh, vehammosif — lo yosif al sheva.

Metivi: omer havedalot bemotzae shabbatot uvemotzae yamim tovim uvemotzae yom hakkippurim, uvemotzae shabbat leyom tov uvemotzae yom tov lechullo shel moed, aval lo bemotzae yom tov leshabbat. haragil — omer harebe, vesheeno ragil — omer achat.

Tannae hi, deamar rabbi yochanan: benan shel kedoshim omer achat, venahagu haam lomar shalosh. man nihu "benan shel kedoshim"? rabbi menachem bar simay. veammay karu leh "benan shel kedoshim"? dela istakkal betzureta dezuza. shelach leh rav shemuel bar idi: chananya achi omer achat. velet hilcheta kevoteh.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hammavdil tzarich sheyyomar meen havedalot haamurot battora. metivi: seder havedalot heach? omer: "hammavdil ben kodesh lechol, ben or lechoshech, ben yisrael laammim, uven yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase, ben tame letahor, ben hayyam lecharava, ben mayim haelyonim lemayim hattachtonim, ben kohanim lilviyyim veyisreelim".

Vechotem beseder bereshit". vaacherim omrim: beyotzer bereshit". rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: chotem "mekaddesh yisrael". veim ita, ha "ben hayyam lecharava" la ketiva beh "havedala"! semi mikkan "ben hayyam lecharava".
I hachi "ben yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase" name? meen chatima hu, betzar chada velekka sheva!

Amri, kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim tere mille ninhu. ben leviyyim leyisreelim, dichtiv: "baet hahi hivdil Adonai et shevet hallevi". ben hakkohanim lalviyyim, dichtiv: "bene amram aharon umoshe vayyibbadel aharon lehakedisho kodesh kadashim".
Michtam may chatem? rav amar: "mekaddesh yisrael", ushemuel amar: "hammavdil ben kodesh lechol". layet ala abbaye veittema rav yosef aha derav.
Tana mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben chananya: kol hachotem "mekaddesh yisrael vehammavdil ben kodesh lechol" maarichin lo yamav ushenotav.
b: Velet hilcheta kevoteh.

Ulla ikkela lefumebdita, amar leh rav yehuda lerav yitzchak bereh: zil amti leh kalkalla defere, vachazi hechi avdel. la azal, shaddar leh leabbaye. ki ata abbaye, amar leh: hechi amar? amar leh: "baruch hammavdil ben kodesh lechol" amar, vetu la.

Ata lekammeh daavu, amar leh: hechi amar? amar leh: ana la azali, ana shadderiteh leabbaye, vaamar li "hammavdil ben kodesh lechol". amar leh: ravrevanuteh demar, useraruteh demar, gerama leh lemar dela tema shemateh mippummeh.
Metivi: kol habberachot kullan poteach bevaruch vechotem bahen bevaruch, chutz mibbirkat mitzvot uvirkat happerot uveracha hassemucha lachavertah uveracha acharona shebbikriyyat shema,
Sheyyesh mehen poteach (bahen) bevaruch veen chotem bevaruch, veyesh mehen shechotem bevaruch veen poteach bevaruch. vehattov vehammetiv" poteach bevaruch veeno chotem bevaruch.

a: Kashya leulla! amar lach ulla: ha name kevirkat hammitzvot damya, birkat hammitzvot may tama? mishshum dehodaa hi — ha name hodaa hi.

Rav chananya bar shelemya vetalmide derav havo yatvi bisodta, vekae alayyhu rav hamenuna sava. amaru leh: zil chazi i mikkedish yoma nafsik venikbeeh leshabbeta. amar lehu: la tzerichitu — shabbeta kava nafsha.
Deamar rav: keshem shehashshabbat kovaat lemaaser, kach shabbat kovaat lekiddush.
Sevur minna ki hechi dekava lekiddush kach kava lehavedala, amar lehu rav amram, hachi amar rav: lekiddush kovaat, velo lehavedala kovaat.
Vehane mille leinyan mifsak dela mafsekinan, aval atchole la matchalinan. umifsak name la amaran ella baachila, aval bishtiyya — la.
Ushetiyya name la amaran ella bechamra veshichra, aval mayya — let lan ba.

Ufeliga derav huna. derav huna chazyeh lehahu gavra dishta mayya kodem havedala. amar leh: la mistefe mar measkara? detana mishshemeh derabbi akiva: kol hattoem kelum kodem sheyyavdil — mitato beaskara. rabbanan deve rav ashe la kafdi ammayya.

Bea minneh ravina merav nachman bar yitzchak: mi shello kiddesh beerev shabbat mahu sheyyekaddesh veholech kol hayyom kullo? amar leh: middeamri bene rabbi chiyyay: mi shello hivdil bemotzae shabbat — mavdil veholech kol hashshabbat kullo, hacha name: mi shello kiddesh beerev shabbat — mekaddesh veholech kol hayyom kullo.
Etiveh: lele shabbat velele yom tov yesh bahen kedushsha al hakkos veyesh bahen hazekara bevirkat hammazon. shabbat veyom tov — en bahem kedushsha al hakkos, veyesh bahen hazekara bevirkat hammazon.

Vei salka datach mi shello kiddesh beerev shabbat mekaddesh veholech kol hayyom kullo, shabbat veyom tov name mashkachat lehu deyesh bahen kedushsha al hakkos, dei la kaddesh meureta mekaddesh limchar! amar leh: "dei" la katane.
Etiveh: kevod yom uchevod layla kevod yom kodem. veim en lo ella kos echad — omer alav
b: Kiddush hayyom, mippene shekkiddush hayyom kodem lichvod yom (uchevod layla). veim ita — lishbekeh ad limchar, velebed beh tarte! amar leh: chaviva mitzva bishatah.

Umi amrinan chaviva mitzva bishatah? veha tanya: hannichnas leveto bemotzae shabbat mevarech al hayyayin veal hammaor veal habbesamim, veachar kach omer havedala al hakkos. veim en lo ella kos echad — mannicho ad leachar hammazon umeshalshelan kullan leacharav, vela amrinan chaviva mitzva bishatah!

Amar leh: ana la chakkimaa ana, vela chozaa ana, vela yechidaa ana, ella gamrana vesadrana ana, vechen morin beve midresha kevoti. shane lan ben ayyole yoma leappoke yoma: ayyole yoma — kol kamma demakdeminan leh adif, umechabbevinan leh. appoke yoma — meacharinan leh, ki hechi dela leheve alan ketuna.
Shema minna miha matnita tamne. shema minna: hammavdil bitfilla — tzarich sheyyavdil al hakkos.
Ushema minna: beracha teuna kos. ushema minna: kos shel beracha tzarich shiur.
Ushema minna: hamevarech tzarich sheyyitom. ushema minna: teamo — pegamo. ushema minna: taam mavdil.

a: Ushema minna: omer shete kedushshot al kos echad. ushema minna: bet shammay hi, veallibba derabbi yehuda.
Rav ashe amar: teamo pegamo vechos shel beracha tzarich shiur — chada milleta hi.
Vehachi kaamar: may tama teamo pegamo? mishshum dechos shel beracha tzarich shiur.
Rabbi yaakov bar idi kafed achatzba pegima. rav idi bar shisha kafed akkasa pegima. mar bar rav ashe kafed afillu achavita pegimta.
Tanu rabbanan: "zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho" — zochrehu al hayyayin. en li ella beyom, ballayla minnayin? talmud lomar: "zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho".

"Ballayla minnayin"?! adderabba, ikkar kiddusha ballayla hu kadesh, dechi kadesh — techillat yoma bae lekaydoshe! vetu: "ballayla minnayin talmud lomar: zachor et yom", tanna meyhaddar allayla veka nasev leh kera dimama?!
Hachi kaamar: "zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho" — zochrehu al hayyayin bichnisato, en li ella ballayla, bayyom minnayin? talmud lomar: "zachor et yom hashshabbat".
Beyom may mevarech? amar rav yehuda: "bore peri haggefen". rav ashe ikkela lemachoza, amaru leh: likaddesh lan mar kiddusha rabba (havu leh).

Sevar: may nihu "kiddusha rabba"? amar, mikkede kol habberachot kullan "bore peri haggefen" amri beresha, amar "bore peri haggefen" veagged beh. chazyeh lehahu sava degachen veshate, kare annafsheh "hechacham enav berosho".
Amri bene rabbi chiyyay: mi shello hivdil bemotzae shabbat — mavdil veholech bechol hashshabbat kullo. vead kamma? amar rabbi zera: ad revii beshabbat.

Ki ha deyatev rabbi zera kammeh derav assi, veamri la rav assi kammeh derabbi yochanan, veyatev vekaamar: leinyan gittin, chada beshabbeta tere utelata — batar shabbeta. arba vechamsha umaale yoma — kamme shabbeta.
Amar rabbi yaakov bar idi: aval lo al haur.
Amar rav berona amar rav:
b: Hannotel yadav lo yekaddesh. amar lehu rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta: akkatti la nach nafsheh derav shechachninhu lishmateteh. zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh derav, zimnin dachaviva aleh rifta — mekaddesh arifta. zimnin dachaviva leh chamra — mekaddesh achamra.
Amar rav huna amar rav: taam eno mekaddesh. bea minneh rav chana bar chinnana merav huna: taam mahu sheyyavdil? amar leh, ani omer: taam — mavdil, verav assi amar: taam — eno mavdil.
Rav yirmeya bar abba ikkela leve rav assi, ishteli vetaim midde, havu leh kasa veavdel. amara leh devethu: veha mar la aved hachi! amar la: shivkeh, kerabbeh sevira leh.
Amar rav yosef amar shemuel: taam — eno mekaddesh, taam — eno mavdil. verabba amar rav nachman amar shemuel: taam — mekaddesh, vetaam — mavdil.

a: Amar rava: hilcheta, taam — mekaddesh, vetaam — mavdil, umi shello kiddesh beerev shabbat — mekaddesh veholech kol hayyom kullo ad motzae shabbat. mi shello hivdil bemotzae shabbat — mavdil veholech kol hashshabbat kullo.

Ammemar patach la leha shemata derava behay lishshana, amar rava: hilcheta, taam — mekaddesh, taam — mavdil, mi shello kiddesh baerev shabbat — mekaddesh veholech kol hayyom kullo, mi shello hivdil bemotzae shabbat — mavdil veholech kol hayyom kullo.

Amri leh mar yanoka umar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe: zimna chada ikkela ammemar leatrin, vela hava lan chamra. ayytina leh shichra, vela avdel uvat tevot. limchar, terachna veayytina leh chamra, veavdel uteem midde. leshana tu ikkela leatrin, la hava lan chamra, ayytina shichra, amar: i hachi, chamar medina hu, avdel uteem midde.

Shema minna telat. shema minna: hammavdil bitfilla, tzarich sheyyavdil al hakkos. ushema minna: asur lo laadam sheyyochal kodem sheyyavdil. ushema minna: mi shello hivdil bemotzae shabbat, mavdil veholech kol hashshabbat kullo.

Bea minneh rav huna merav chisda: mahu lekaddoshe ashshichra? amar: hasheta uma pirzuma uteene veasne divay minneh merav, verav merabbi chiyyay, verabbi chiyyay merabbi, vela peshat leh — shichra mibbaya?!

Sevur minna kaddoshe hu dela mekaddeshinan illaveh, aval avdole mavdelinan. amar lehu rav chisda: hachi amar rav: keshem sheen mekaddeshin alav, kach en mavdilin alav. ittemar name, amar rav tachlifa bar avimi amar shemuel: keshem sheen mekaddeshin alav, kach en mavdilin alav.

Levi shaddar leh lerabbi shichra bar telesar megane, tameh — hava besim tuva, amar: kegon ze rauy lekaddesh alav velomar alav kol shirot vetushebachot shebbaolam. belelya tzaareh. amar: meyasseran umefayyes.
Amar rav yosef: eddor barabbim dela ishte shichra. amar rava: ishte me zureyon vela ishte shichra.
Veamar rava: tehve shakyuteh shichra man dimkaddesh ashshichra. rav, ashkecheh rav huna dekaddesh ashshichra, amar leh: share abba lemikne istere mishshichra.

Tanu rabbanan: en mekaddeshin ella al hayyayin, veen mevarchin ella al hayyayin. attu ashshichra veammayya mi la mevarchin alayhu shehakkol nihye bidvaro? amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: en omrim "have kos shel beracha levarech" ella al hayyayin. tanu rabbanan: en mekaddeshin al hashshechar. mishshum rabbi elazar bar rabbi shimon amru: mekaddeshin.
Matemet yayin kol shehu. rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: melo lugema. amar rav huna amar rav, vechen tane rav giddel demin naresh: hamekaddesh vetaam melo lugema — yatza, veim lav — lo yatza.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ana tenena la la giddol bar menashsheya vela giddol bar minyome ella giddol setama. lemay nafka minna? lemirma dideh addideh.
Samuch lammincha. ibbaya lehu: samuch lemincha gedola tenan, o dilma samuch lemincha ketanna tenan?
Samuch lemincha gedola tenan — umishshum pesach, dilma ate lemimmeshach,
b: Veate leimmenoe millemibad pischa. o dilma, samuch lemincha ketanna tenan — umishshum matztza, dilma ate lemechla lematztza achila gassa.
Amar ravina, ta shema: afillu agrippas hammelech shehu ragil leechol betesha shaot — oto hayyom lo yochal ad shettechshach. i amrat bishlama samuch lemincha ketanna tenan, hayeynu revuteh deagrippas.
Ella i amrat samuch lemincha gedola tenan, may revuteh deagrippas? chal issur aleh meikkara! ella samuch lemincha ketanna tenan.
Sof sof may revuteh deagrippas, ha matya leh zeman issura! mahu detema tesha shaot leagrippas kearba shaot didan dame, ka mashma lan.
Amar rabbi (yose): aval metabbel hu bemine targima. rabbi yitzchak metabbel beyarke. tanya name hachi: hashshammash metabbel bivne meayin venotnan lifne haorchim.
Veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar, shenneemar: "niru lachem nir veal tizreu el kotzim".
Rava hava shate chamra kulle maale yoma defischa, ki hechi denigrereh lelibbeh denechol matztza tefe leureta. amar rava: mena amena la dechamra migrar garer, ditnan:

a: Ben hakkosot hallalu im ratza lishtot — yishte, ben shelishi lirvii — lo yishte. vei amrat misad saed, ammay yishte? ha ka achel lematztza achila gassa. ella shema minna: migrar garer.
Rav sheshet hava yatev betaanita kol maale yoma defischa. nema ka savar rav sheshet: samuch lemincha gedola tenan — umishshum pischa hu, dilma mimmeshach veate leimmenoe millemebad pischa hu,
Vesavar la ki ha deamar rabbi oshaya amar rabbi elazar: machshir haya ben betera befesach sheshshechato shacharit bearbaa asar lishmo, umitztzafra zeman pischa hu, dechulle yoma chaze lefischa,
Desavar "ben haarbayim" — ben erev deetmol leerev dehaiddana.
Amri: la, shane rav sheshet deistenis hava, dei taem betzafra midde, leureta la hava mahne leh mechla.

Vaafillu ani shebbeyisrael lo yochal ad sheyyasev. ittemar: matztza tzarich hasibba, maror en tzarich hasibba. yayin, ittemar mishshemeh derav nachman: tzarich hasibba. veittemar mishshemeh derav nachman: en tzarich hasibba.

Vela peligi: ha betarte kase kammae, ha betarte kase batrae. amri la lehay gisa veamri la lehay gisa. amri la lehay gisa: tere kase kammae — bau hasibba, dehashta hu deka matchala la cherut. tere kase batrae — la bau hasibba, may dahava hava.

Veamri la lehay gisa: adderabba, tere kase batrae — bau hasibba, hahi shata deka havya cherut. tere kase kammae — la bau hasibba, deakkatti "avadim hayinu" kaamar. hasheta deittemar hachi veittemar hachi, idde veidde bau hasibba.
Perakdan la shemeh hasibba. hasibbat yamin la shema hasibba. velo od, ella shemma yakdim kane levevshet, veyavo lide sakkana.
Ishsha etzel balah la baaya hasibba, veim ishsha chashuva hi — tzericha hasibba. ben etzel aviv bae hasibba. ibbaya lehu: talmid etzel rabbo may?
Ta shema, (amar) abbaye: ki havenan be mar zegenan abbirche dahadade, ki atenan leve rav yosef, amar lan: la tzerichitu, mora rabbach kemora shamayim.
Metivi: im hakkol adam mesev, vaafillu talmid etzel rabbo! ki tanya hahi — bishvalya denaggare.
Ibbaya lehu: shammash may? ta shema, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hashshammash sheachal kezayit matztza keshehu mesev — yatza. mesev — in, lo mesev — la. shema minna: bae hasibba. shema minna.
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: nashim chayyayvot bearbaa kosot hallalu,
b: Sheaf hen hayu beoto hannes.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: arbaa kosot hallalu tzarich sheyyehe bahen kede mezigat kos yafe. shetaan chay — yatza. shetaan bevat achat — yatza. hishka mehen levanav velivne veto — yatza.
Shetaan chay yatza, amar rava: yede yayin — yatza, yede cherut — lo yatza.
Shetaan bevat achat, rav amar: yede yayin — yatza, yede arbaa kosot — lo yatza. hishka mehen levanav velivne veto — yatza, amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: vehu deishti rubba dechasa.

Metivi: arbaa kosot hallalu tzarich sheyyehe bahen kede reviit, echad chay veechad mazug, echad chadash veechad yashan. rabbi yehuda omer: tzarich sheyyehe bo taam umare yayin. katane mihat kede reviit, veat amrat kos yafe!
Amri: idde veidde chad shiura hu, may "kede mezigat kos yafe" dekaamar — lechol chad vechad, dehave lehu kullehu reviit.
Rabbi yehuda omer: tzarich sheyyehe bo taam umare. amar rava: may tama derabbi yehuda, dichtiv: "al tere yayin ki yitaddam".
Tanu rabbanan: hakkol chayyayvin bearbaa kosot hallalu, echad anashim, veechad nashim, veechad tinokot. amar rabbi yehuda: vechi ma toelet yesh letinokot beyayin? ella mechallekin lahen

a: Kelayot veegozin beerev pesach kede shello yishnu, veyishalu. amru alav al rabbi akiva shehaya mechallek kelayot veegozin letinokot beerev pesach kede shello yishnu, veyishalu. tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: chotfin matztzot belele pesachim bishvil tinokot shello yishnu.

Tanya, amru alav al rabbi akiva: miyyamav lo amar higgia et laamod bevet hammidrash, chutz mearve fesachim veerev yom hakkippurim. beerev pesach — bishvil tinokot, kede shello yishnu. veerev yom hakkippurim — kede sheyyaachilu et benehem.
Tanu rabbanan: chayyayv adam lesammeach banav uvene veto baregel, shenneemar: "vesamachta bechaggecha". bamme mesammecham — beyayin.

Rabbi yehuda omer: anashim barauy lahem, venashim barauy lahen. anashim barauy lahem — beyayin. venashim bemay? tane rav yosef: bevavel — bevigde tzivonin, beeretz yisrael — bevigde pishtan megohatzin.

Tanya, rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym en simcha ella bevasar, shenneemar: "vezavachta shelamim veachalta sham vesamachta lifne Adonai elohecha", veachshav sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym, en simcha ella beyayin, shenneemar: "veyayin yesammach levav enosh".

Amar rabbi yitzchak: kista demureysa dahava betzippori hi havat kemin lugga demakdesha, uvah meshaarin reviit shel pesach. amar rabbi yochanan: temanyayta kadmayyta dahava bitverya havat yattira al da riva, uvah meshaarin reviit shel pesach.

Amar rav chisda: reviit shel tora etzbaayim al etzbaayim berum etzbaayim vachatzi etzba vechomesh etzba. kidtanya: "verachatz bammayim et kol besaro" — shello yehe davar chotzetz ben besaro lammayim. "bammayim" — beme mikve. "et kol besaro" — mayim shekkol gufo ole bahen, vechamma hen?
b: Amma al amma berum shalosh ammot, veshiaru chachamim shiur me mikve arbaim sea.
Amar rav ashe: amar li ravin bar chinnana, shulechan shel mikdash — shel perakim hava, dei salka datach haddoke hava mihaddak, ammeta beammeta hechi matbeleh?!
May kusheya? dilma beyam sheasa shelomo hava matbel leh. detane rabbi chiyyay: yam sheasa shelomo machazik mea vachamishshim mikve tohora.
Velo yifchatu lo mearbaa. hechi metakkeni rabbanan midde deate be lide sakkana, vehatanya: lo yochal adam tere, velo yishte tere, velo yekannach tere, velo yaase tzerachav tere?
Amar rav nachman, amar kera: "lel shimmurim" — layil hameshummar uva min hammazzikin.
Rava amar: kos shel beracha mitztaref letova, veeno mitztaref leraa. ravina amar: arbaa kase takkinu rabbanan derech cherut, kol chad vechad

a: Mitzva beappe nafsha hu.
"Lo yaase tzerachav tere", ammay? nimlach hu! amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: lo yochal tere veyishte tere, velo yaase tzerachav afillu paam achat — dilma chalesh umittera.

Tanu rabbanan: shote kiflayim — damo berosho. amar rav yehuda: ematay — bizman shello raa pene hashshuk, aval raa pene hashshuk — harshut beyado. amar rav ashe: chazena leh lerav chananya bar bivi, deakkol kasa hava nafek vechaze appe shuka.

Vela amaran ella latzet ladderech, aval beveto — la. amar rabbi zera: uleyashen — kelatzet ladderech dame. amar rav pappa: velatzet levet hakkisse — kelatzet ladderech dame. uveveto la? veha rava mane keshure.

Veabbaye, ki shate chad kasa, menakket leh immeh tere chase bitre yedeh. verav nachman bar yitzchak, ki hava shate tere chase, menakket leh shammaeh chad kasa, chad kasa — menakket leh tere chase bitre yedeh! adam chashuv shane.

Amar ulla: asara kosot en bahem mishshum zugot. ulla letameh, deamar ulla, veamri la bematnita tana: asara kosot tikkenu chachamim bevet haevel, vei salka datach asara kosot yesh bahen mishshum zugot, hechi kayymi rabbanan vetakkinu milleta deate lide sakkana?! aval temanya yesh bahen mishshum zugot.
Rav chisda verabba bar rav huna deamri tarvayyhu: "shalom", letova — mitztaref, leraa — lo mitztaref. aval shitta yesh bahen mishshum zugot.
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: "vichunnekka", letova — mitztaref. leraa — lo mitztaref. aval arbaa yesh bahen mishshum zugot.
Abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: "veyishmerecha", letova — mitztaref, leraa — lo mitztaref.
Veazda rava letameh, derava appekinhu lerabbanan bearbaa kosot, af al gav deittazzak rava bar levay, la chash la lemilleta, deamar: hahu mishshum deotvan befirka hava.

Amar rav yosef, amar li yosef sheda: ashmeday malka deshede — memunne hu akkullehu zuge, umalka la ikkeri mazzik. ikka deamri la lehay gisa: adderabba, malka [ratchana hu], may devae aved, shehammelech poretz gader laasot lo derech veen mochin beyado.
Amar rav pappa, amar li yosef sheda: bitre katlinan, bearbea la katlinan, bearbea mazzekinan. bitre, ben beshogeg ben bemezid. bearbea, bemezid — in, beshogeg — la.

Vei ishteli veikkeri unefak, may takkanteh? linkot zakpa dideh deyammineh bida dismaleh vezakpa dismaleh bida deyammineh, venema hachi: "attun vaana — ha telata". vei shemia leh deamar: "attun vaana — ha arbea", nema leh: "attun vaana — ha chamsha". vei shemia leh deamar: "attun vaana — ha shitta", nema leh: "attun vaana — ha shiva". hava ovada ad mea vechad, ufeka sheda.

Amar ammemar: amara li reshatinhi denashim kashfaniyyot: hay man defaga behu benashim kashfaniyyot, nema hachi: "chare chammime bedikkula bazyay lefummayychu neshe decharashayyay, karach karchayychi, parach parchayychi,
b: Ibbaddur tavlunayychi, parcha zika lemorika chadta denaktitu nashim kashfaniyyot, addechannanni vechannanchi la ateti lego, hasheta daateti lego — karchanni vachananchi".

Bemareva la kafdi azzuge. rav dimi minnehardea kafed afillu arushema dechavita. hava ovada ufeka chavita. kelala demilleta, kol dekafed — kafdi bahadeh, udela kafed — la kafdi bahadeh, umihu lemechash mibbee.

Ki ata rav dimi, amar: shete vetzim, ushete egozin, shete kishshuin, vedavar acher — halacha lemoshe missinay. umistappeka lehu lerabbanan may nihu davar acher, ugezur rabbanan bechullehu zuge mishshum davar acher.
Veha daamaran asara, temanya, shitta, arbea en bahen mishshum zuge, la amaran ella leinyan mazzikin. aval leinyan keshafim — afillu tuva name chayyshinan.
Ki ha dehahu gavra degarsha lidvethu. (azil) innasva lechanvaa. kol yoma hava azel veshate chamra. hava ka avda leh keshafim vela ka mahneya la beh, mishshum dahava mizdehar benafsheh bezuga.

Yoma chad ishti tuva, vela hava yada kamma shate. ad shittesar hava tzeyil veizdehar benafsheh, mikkan veelach la hava tzeyil vela izdehar benafsheh, appekteh bezuga. ki hava azel, gas beh hahu tayyaya, amar leh: gavra ketila hu deazel hacha. azel chabbekeh ledikla, tzevavch dikla ufeka hu.
Amar rav avvira: kearot vechikkarot en bahem mishshum zugot. kelala demilleta: kol sheggemaro bide adam — en bahen mishshum zugot. gemaro bide shamayim — bemille mine demechal chayyshinan.
Chanut — en bahen mishshum zugot. nimlach — en bahen mishshum zugot. oreach — en bo mishshum zugot. ishsha — en bah mishshum zugot. vei ishsha chashuva, chayyshinan.
Amar rav chinnana bereh derabbi yehoshua: isparagos — mitztaref letova, veen mitztaref leraa.
Amar ravina mishshemeh derava: zuge — lechumera. veamri leh: zuge — lekulla. amar rav yosef: tere dechamra vechad deshichra — la mitztaref, tere deshichra vechad dechamra — mitztaref.
Vesimanaych, ze hakkelal: kol hamechubbar lo min hechamur mimmennu — tame, min hakkal mimmennu — tahor.
Amar rav nachman amar rav: tere kamme takka vechad attakka — mitztarfi. chad mikkamme takka utere attakka — lo mitztarfin.
Matkef la rav mesharsheya: attu anan letakkone takka ka baenan? letakkone gavra baenan, vegavra ka mittekan vekae.
(Ella amar rav mesharsheya): dechulle alma tere attakka vechad levatar takka — la mitztarfi. ki hahi maase derabba bar nachmani.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol hammazug — mitztaref,

a: Chutz min hammayim. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu mayim. amar rav pappa: la amaran, ella chammime lego karire, vekarire lego chammime. aval chammime lego chammime, vekarire lego karire — la.

Amar resh lakish: arbaa devarim haose otan damo berosho umitchayyev benafsho. ellu hen: hannifne ben dekel lechotel, vehaover ben shene dekalim, vehashshote mayim sheulin, vehaover al mayim shefuchin, vaafillu shefachattu ishto befanav.

Hannifne ben dekel lechotel — la amaran ella delet leh arba ammot, aval it leh arba ammot — let lan ba. vechi let leh arba ammot, la amaran ella delekka dirka acharina, aval ikka dirka acharina — let lan ba.

Vehaover ben shene dekalim — la amaran ella dela paskinhu reshut harabbim, aval paskinhu reshut harabbim — let lan ba. hashshote mayim sheulin — la amaran ella deshayylinhu katan, aval gadol — let lan ba.
Vaafillu shayylinhu katan name — la amaran ella bassade, dela shechichi, aval bair, dishchichi — let lan bah. vaafillu bassade name — la amaran ella mayya, aval chamra veshichra — let lan ba.

Vehaover al mayim shefuchin — la amaran ella dela afsekinhu beafra vela taf behu rukka, aval afsekinhu o taf behu rukka — let lan ba. vela amaran ella dela avar alayyhu shimsha vela avar alayyhu shittin nigre, aval avar alayyhu shimsha vaavar alayyhu shittin nigre — let lan ba. vela amaran ella dela rechiv chamara vela sayem mesane, aval rechiv chamara vesayem mesane — let lan ba.

Vehane mille hecha delekka lemechash lichshafim, aval hecha deikka lemechash lichshafim, af al gav deikka kol hane — chayyshinan. (vehahu) gavra dirchiv chamara vesayem mesane, ugemud mesaneh utzevo kareh.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha en mematztzein velo mitmatztzein. veellu hen: hakkelev vehaddekel vehaishsha. veyesh omrim: af hachazir, veyesh omrim: af hannachash.
Vei mematztzein may takkanteh? amar rav pappa: niftach beel" venafsek beel".
I name, niftach belo" venafsek belo".
Hane be tere dematztzaa lehu ishsha nidda, im techillat niddatah hi — horeget echad mehen, im sof niddatah hi — meriva osa benehen. may takkanteh? niftach beel" venafsek beel".

Hane tere neshe deyatvan befarashat derachim, chada behay gisa dishvila, vachada beiddach gisa, umechavvevnan appayyhu lahadade — vadday bichshafim asikan. may takkanteh? i ikka dirka acharina — lezil ba. vei lekka dirka acharina, i ikka inish acharina bahadeh — ninketo lidayyhu bahade hadade venichallefu. vei lekka inish acharina, nema hachi: "agrat azlat asya beluseya, mitkatla bechek kaval".

Hay man defaga beitteta beiddana desalka mittevilat mitzva, i ihu kadem umeshammesh — achada leh ledideh ruach zenunim. i ihi kadma umeshammesha — achada la ledida ruach zenunim. may takkanteh? lema hachi: "shofech buz al nedivim vayyatem betohu lo darech".

Amar rabbi yitzchak, may dichtiv: "gam ki elech bege tzalmavet lo ira ra ki atta immadi" — ze hayyashen betzel dekel yechidi, uvetzel levana. uvetzel dekel yechidi — la amaran ella dela nafel tulla dechavreh illaveh, aval nafel tulla dechavreh illaveh — let lan ba.

Ella ha detanya: hayyashen betzel dekel yechidi bechatzer, vehayyashen betzel levana — damo berosho, hechi dame? i lema dela nafel tulla dechavreh illaveh, afillu bassade name! ella lav shema minna: bechatzer af al gav denafel tulla dechavreh illaveh. shema minna.
Uvetzillah shel levana — la amaran ella bemareva, aval bemaddinchata — let lan ba.
b: Hay man demippene aggirda dedikla — achada leh ledideh ruach palga. vehay man dematzle resheh aggirda dedikla — achada leh ruach tzerada. hay man defasi addikla, i mikketal — ketil, i iakar — miakar umayet. hane mille dela mannach kareh illaveh, aval mannach kareh — illaveh let lan ba.
Chamishsha tulle have: tulla dedikla yechida, tulla dechinnada, tulla defircha, tulla dezardeta. ikka deamri: af tulla dearba, vetulla daaravta. kelala demilleta: kol dinfish anfeh — keshe tulleh,

Vechol dikshe silveh — keshe tulleh, levar mikkeru mesha, af al gav dikshe silveh — la keshe tulleh, daamara le sheda livra: pirchi nafshaych mikkeru mesha, deihu hu dekatel laavuch, vekatel ledideh. amar rav ashe: chazena lerav kahana defaresh mikkullehu tulle.
Be firche — ruche. deve zardeta — sheda. deve iggare — rishpe. lemay nafka minna? likmia.

Deve firche — beriyya sheen lah enayim. lemay nafka minna — legazzoze la. zimna chada hava azel tzureba merabbanan leippenoye leve firche, shema deka ata illaveh, vegazzi la. ki azla, chabbekay ledikla — tzevavch dikla ufekaa hi.
Pircha deve zardeta — shede. ha zardeta dismicha lemata — la pachata mishshittin shede. lemay nafka minna? lemichtav la kemia.

Hahu bar kashsha demata deazel vekae gabbe zardeta, dahava semich lemata, allu beh shittin shede veistakkan. ata lehahu merabbanan dela yeda dezardeta deshittin shede hi, ketav la kemia lachada sheda. shema detalu chinga begavvevy, veka mesharu hachi: sudareh demar ki tzureba merabbanan, badekna beh bemar dela yada "baruch". ata hahu merabbanan dida dezardeta shittin shede hava, ketav la kemia deshittin shede, shema deka amru: pannu manayychu mehacha.

Ketev meriri — tere kitve havu. chad mikkamme tihara, vechad mibbatar tihara. demikkamme tihara — "ketev meriri" shemo, umichaze be chadda dechamka vehadar beh bachsha. devatar tihara — "ketev yashud tzohorayim" shemo, umichaze be karna deizza, vehadar beh kenafya.

Abbaye hava shakel veazel, veazel rav pappa miyyammineh verav huna bereh derav yehoshua missemaleh. chazyeh lehahu ketev meriri deka ate leappeh dismaleh. ahdere lerav pappa lismaleh, ulerav huna bereh derav yehoshua leyammineh. amar leh rav pappa: ana may shena dela chashesh li? amar leh: at shata kayyma lach.

Mechad betammuz ad shittesar beh — vadday shechichi. mikkan veelach — safek shechichi, safek la shechichi. umishtachchi betulle dechatzba dela chatzav garmida, uvetulle detzafra ufanya dela have garmida, veikkar betulle devet hakkisse.
Amar rav yosef: hane telat mille yahev arbona linhora: man desarek resheh yabbish, uman deshate tif tif, uman desayem mesane addemiytinya kara.

Telay beveta keshe leanyuta. kidamri inashe: tela silta — tela mezoneh. vela amaran ella rifta, aval bisra vechavvre — let lan ba, orcheh hi. pare beveta — keshe leanyuta. nishvara beveta — keshe leanyuta. belele shabbatot uvelele reviit — sharu mazzikin illaveh.

Issara dimzone "nekid" shemeh. issara deanyuta "naval" shemeh. tzaa appumma dechatzba — keshe leanyuta. man deshate mayya betzae — keshe livruketi. deachel tachle vela mashe yedeh — mefached telatin yomin.

a: Dimsochar vela mashe yedeh — mefached shiva yome. deshakel mazyeh vela mashe yedeh — mefached telata yome. deshakel tufereh vela mashe yedeh — mefached chad yoma, vela yada may ka mefached. yeda auseya — darga lefachda. yeda apputa — darga leshinta.

Tana: ochalin umashkin tachat hammitta, afillu mechuppin bichli barzel — ruach raa shora alehen. tanu rabbanan: lo yishte adam mayim lo belele reviiyyot velo belele shabbatot, veim shata — damo berosho mippene sakkana. may sakkana? ruach raa.

Veim tzache may takkanteh? (nema) shiva kolot sheamar david al hammayim, vahadar nishte, shenneemar: "kol Adonai al hammayim el hakkavod hirim Adonai al mayim rabbim kol Adonai bakkoach kol Adonai behadar kol Adonai shover arazim vayshabber Adonai et arze hallevanon kol Adonai chotzev lahavot esh kol Adonai yachil midbar yachil Adonai midbar kadesh kol Adonai yecholel ayyalot vayyechesof yearot uvehechalo kullo omer kavod".

Vei la, (nema) hachi: "lul shafan anigron aniradfin ben kochve yatevna, ben belii shammine azelna". vei la, i ikka inish bahadeh — naytareh velema leh: "pelanya bar pelanita tzachena mayya", vahadar nishte. vei la — mekarkesh nichtema achatzba vahadar nishte. vei la — nishde ba midde, vahadar nishte.

Tanu rabbanan: lo yishte adam mayim lo min hanneharot velo min haagammim ballayla, veim shata — damo berosho, mippene hassakkana. may sakkana? sakkanat shavrire. vei tzache may takkanteh? i ikka inish bahadeh — lema leh: "pelanya bar pelanita, tzachena mayya". vei la, (nema) ihu lenafsheh: "pelanya, amara li immi izdehar mishshavrire shavrire berire rire yere re — tzachena mayya bechase chivvare".
Vaafillu min hattamchuy vechulei. peshita!
Lo nitzrecha ella afillu lerabbi akiva, deamar: ase shabbattecha chol veal titztarech labberiyyot — hacha mishshum parsome nissa (mode).

Tana deve eliyyahu, af al pi sheamar rabbi akiva: ase shabbattecha chol veal titztarech labberiyyot, aval ose hu davar muat betoch beto. may ninhu? amar rav pappa: kasa deharsana. keditnan, rabbi yehuda ben tema omer: heve az kannamer vekal kannesher, ratz katztzevi vegibbor kaari laasot retzon avicha shebbashshamayim.
Tanu rabbanan, shiva devarim tzivva rabbi akiva et rabbi yehoshua beno: beni, al teshev begovhah shel ir vetishne, veal tadur beir sherasheha talmide chachamim.

Veal tikkanes levetcha pitom, kol shekken levet chavercha. veal timna minalim meraglecha. hashekem veechol, bakkayitz mippene hachamma, uvachoref mippene hatztzinna. vaase shabbattecha chol veal titztarech labberiyyot. veheve mishtaddel im adam shehashshaa mesacheket lo.

Amar rav pappa: la lemizban minneh vela lezabbone leh, ella lemebad shuttafut bahadeh. vehasheta deamar rav shemuel bar yitzchak: may dichtiv "maase yadav berachta" — kol hannotel peruta meiyyov mitbarech, afillu lemizban minneh ulezabbone leh shappir dame.

Chamishsha devarim tzivva rabbi akiva et rabbi shimon ben yochay keshehaya chavush bevet haasurin. amar lo: rabbi, lammedeni tora, amar: eni melammedecha. amar lo: im en atta melammedeni ani omer leyochay abba umosercha lammalchut. amar lo: beni, yoter mimma shehaegel rotze linak para rotze lehanik. amar lo: umi besakkana? vahalo egel besakkana.
Amar lo: im bikkashta lechanek — hittale beilan gadol. uchesheatta melammed et bincha — lammedehu besefer muggah. may hi? amar rava, veittema rav mesharsheya: bechadta, shabbeshta kevan deal — al.
Lo tevashshel bikdera shebbishshel bah chaverecha. may nihu — gerusha bechayye balah, deamar mar garush shennasa gerushah — arba deot bammitta. vei baet ema: afillu bealmana, lefi
b: Sheen kol etzbaot shavot.
Mitzva veguf gadol — ochel perot velo sachar. mitzva veguf tahor — nose ishsha velo banim.
Arbaa devarim tzivva rabbenu hakkadosh et banav: al tadur beshachnetziv mishshum deletzane havu, umashchu lach beletzanuta.
Veal teshev al mittat arammit. ikka deamri: dela tigne bela keriyyat shema. veikka deamri: dela tinsav giyyorta.
Veikka deamri: arammait mammash, umishshum maase derav pappa.

Veel tavriach atzmecha min hammeches, dilma mashkechu lach veshakli minnach kol deit lach. veal taamod bifne hashshor beshaa sheole min haagam, mippene shehassatan merakked ben karnav. amar rabbi shemuel: beshor shachor, uveyome nisan.
Tane rav oshaya: marchikin mishshor tam — chamishshim amma, mishshor muad — kimlo enav.

Tana mishshemeh derabbi meir: resh tora bedikkula — sak leiggara ushedi darga mittutach. amar rav: nizha detora — "hen hen". nizha dearya — "ze ze". nizha degamla — "da da". nizha dearba — "heleni hayyay hila vehilluk huleya".

Amar abbaye: or, dag, vechos, chammin, uvetzim, vechinnim levanim — kullan kashin ledavar acher. or — man degane ammashka detzalla. dag — shibbuta beyome nisan. kos — shiyyure kasa deharsana. chammin — chammime dechammime meshadderu illaveh. betzim — man dimdarech akkelippim. kinnim levanim — man dimchavvavr levusheh vela nater leh temanya yome vahadar lavesh le — baryayn hanach kinnim, vekashyan ledavar acher.

Amar rav pappa: beta deit beh shunnara la neul ba inish bela mesane. may tama — mishshum deshunnara katel lechivya veachel leh, veit beh bechivya garme kattine, vei yatev le garma dechivya akkareh — la nafek veistakkan leh. ikka deamri: beta delet beh shunnara — la neul beh inish behachera, may tama — dilma mikkerich beh chivya vela yada umistakkan.

Shelosha devarim tzivva rabbi yishmael berabbi yose et rabbi: (440 siman) al taas mum beatzmecha. may hi? la tehve lach dina bahade telata, dechad have baal dinach utere sahade. veal taamod al hammikkach beshaa sheen lecha damim.
Ishtecha tavla — al tizzakek lah layla harishona. amar rav: uvenidda deorayyta, hoil vehuchezak mayan patuach, dilma mashcha ziva.

Shelosha devarim tzivva rabbi yose berabbi yehuda et rabbi: al tetze yechidi ballayla, veal taamod bifne hanner arom, veal tikkanes lemerchatz chadash, shemma tippachet. ad kamma? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: ad shenem asar chodesh. veal taamod bifne hanner arom, detanya: haomed bifne hanner arom — have nichpe. vehameshammesh mittato leor hanner — havayin lo banim nichpin.

Tanu rabbanan: hameshammesh mittato al mitta shettinok yashen aleha — oto tinok nichpe. vela amaran ella dela have bar shatta, aval have bar shatta — let lan ba. vela amaran ella degane lahade kareh, aval gane lahade resheh — let lan ba. vela amaran ella dela mannach yedeh illaveh, aval mannach yedeh illaveh — let lan ba.

El tetze yechidi ballayla, detanya: lo yetze yechidi ballayla, lo belele reviiyyot velo belele shabbatot, mippene sheagrat bat machalat, hi ushemone esre ribbo shel malache chabbala yotzin, vechol echad veechad yesh lo reshut lechabbel bifne atzmo.

Meikkara havo shechichi kulle yoma. zimna chada pegaa berabbi chanina ben dosa, amara leh: i lav demachrezin alach berakia: "hizzaharu bachanina uvetorato" — sakkantaych. amar la: i chashivna berakia, gozer ani alayich shello taavori bayyishshuv leolam. amara leh: bematuta minnach, shevok li ravvcha pureta. shevak la lele shabbatot velele reviiyyot.

Vetu: chada zimna pegaa beh beabbaye, amara leh: i lav demachrezi alach berakia: "hizzaharu benachmani uvetorato" — hava sakkantaych. amar la: i chashivna berakia, gozrani alayychi shello taavuri bayyishshuv leolam. ha ka chazenan deavra?! amri: hane

a: Gazyayta ninhu, deshamti susayya veatu davri lehu.
(Vaamar leh) rav lerav assi: la tedur bemata dela tzanef ba suseya vela navach ba kalba. veal tadur beir deresh mata asya, vela tinsev tarte. i nasvat tarte — nesev telat.

Amar leh rav lerav kahana: hafoch binvelta vela tefoch bemille. peshot nevelta beshuka ushekel agra, vela tema "kahana ana, vegavra rabba ana, vesanya bi milleta". salkat leiggara — sherutach bahadach. mea kare bemata bezuza — tute kanfaych nihvo.
Amar leh rav lechiyyay bereh: la tishte samma, vela teshavvavr nigra, vela tikar kakka, vela tekanne bechivya, vela tekanne bearmaa.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha en mitkannein bahen, veellu hen: goy katan, venachash katan, vetalmid katan. may tama — demalchutayyhu achore udenayyhu kae.

Amar leh rav leayvu bereh: terachi bach bishmata vela mistayyay milleta. ta agmerach mille dealma. addechala akkaraycha — zevinach zabben. kol mille zabben veticharat — bar mechamra, dezabben vela ticharat.
Shere kisaych, petach sakkaycha. kabba meara, vela kora meiggara.

Tamre bachaluzach — levet sudana rehot. vead kamma? amar rava: ad telat sea. amar rav pappa: i la dirmay shichra la iattari. ikka deamri, amar rav chisda: i la dirmay shichra la iattari: may "sudana"? amar rav chisda: sod nae, ugemilut chasadim.
Amar rav pappa: kol aggav — geviyya bae. kol ashray — safek ate safek la ate. udeate — maot raot ninhu.

Shelosha devarim amar rabbi yochanan mishshum anshe yerushalayim: kesheatta yotze lammilchama — al tetze barishona, ella tetze baacharona, kede shettikkanes barishona. vaase shabbattecha chol, veal titztarech labberiyyot. veheve mishtaddel im mi shehashshaa mesacheket lo.

Shelosha devarim amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum anshe yerushalayim: al tarbe bignut, mishshum maase shehaya. bittecha bagra — shachrer avdecha veten lah. veheve zahir beishtecha mechatanah harishon. may tama? rav chisda amar: mishshum erva, rav kahana amar: mishshum mamon. ha veha itanhu.

Amar rabbi yochanan: shelosha minnochale haolam habba. ellu hen: haddar beeretz yisrael, vehamegaddel banav letalmud tora, vehammavdil al hayyayin bemotzae shabbatot. may hi? dimshayyayr mikkiddusha leavdalta.

Amar rabbi yochanan, shelosha machriz alehen hakkadosh baruch hu bechol yom: al rauok haddar bichrach veeno chote, veal ani hammachazir aveda livaleha, veal ashir hameasser perotav betzina. rav safra rauok haddar bichrach hava,
b: Tane tanna kammeh derava verav safra, tzahavu panav derav safra. amar lo rava: lav kegon mar, ella kegon rav chanina verav oshaya dahavo ushekafe beara deyisrael, vahavo yatvi beshuka dezonot, veavdi lehu mesane lezonot, veayyli lehu. inhu mistakkeli behu, veinhu la madlan enayyhu leistakkole behu. umomatayyhu hachi: bechayyehen rabbanan kaddishe divara deyisrael.

Shelosha hakkadosh baruch hu ohavan: mi sheeno koes, umi sheeno mishtakker, umi sheeno maamid al middotav. shelosha hakkadosh baruch hu sonan: hamedabber echad bappe veechad ballev, vehayyodea edut bachavero veeno meid lo, veharoe devar erva bachavero umeid bo yechidi.

Ki ha detoviyya chata, vaata ziggud lechudeh veashed beh kammeh derav pappa. naggedeh leziggud. amar leh: toviyya chata veziggud minnaggad?! amar leh: in, dichtiv: "lo yakum ed echad beish", veat lechodach ashedt beh, shem ra bealma ka mappekat beh.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak amar rav: muttar lisnoto. shenneemar: "ki tire chamor sonaacha rovetz tachat massao". may "sone"? illema sone goy, veha tanya: sone sheamru — sone yisrael velo sone goy.

Ella peshita, sone yisrael. umi shere lemisneye? vehachtiv: "lo tisna et achicha bilvavecha". ella deikka sahadi deaved issura — kulle alma name misne sane leh, may shena hay? ella lav ki hay gavvna, dachazay beh ihu devar erva.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: mitzva lisnoto. shenneemar: "yirat Adonai (sone) ra". amar rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: mahu lememra leh lerabbeh lemisneyeh? amar leh: i yada dimheman lerabbeh keve tere — lema leh, vei la — la lema leh.
Tanu rabbanan, shelosha chayyehen enam chayyim: harachmanin, veharatchanin, vaanine haddaat. veamar rav yosef: kullehu itanhu bi.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha sonin ze et ze, ellu hen: hakkelavim, vehattarnegolin, vehachabbarin. veyesh omrim: af hazzonot. veyesh omrim: af talmide chachamim shebbevavel.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha ohavin ze et ze, ellu hen: haggerim, vaavadim, veorvin.
Arbaa en haddaat sovaltan, ellu hen: dal gee, veashir mechachesh, vezaken menaef, ufarnas mitgae al hatztzibbur bechinnam. veyesh omrim: af hamegaresh et ishto paam rishona usheniyya umachzirah.
Vetanna kamma? zimna dichtubbatah merubba. i name: yesh lo banim hemenna vela matze megaresh la.
Chamishsha devarim tzivva kenaan et banav: ehevu ze et ze, veehevu et haggazel, veehevu et hazzimma, vesinu et adonechem, veal tedabberu emet.
Shishsha devarim neemarim bassus: ohev et hazzenut, veohev et hammilchama, verucho gassa, umoes et hashshena, veochel harebe umotzi kima. veyesh omrim: af mevakkesh laharog bealav bammilchama.

Shiva menuddin lashshamayim, ellu hen: (yehudi) [mi] sheen lo ishsha, vesheyyesh lo ishsha veen lo banim, umi sheyyesh lo banim veen megaddelan letalmud tora, umi sheen lo tefillin berosho utefillin bizroo vetzitzit bevigdo umezuza befitcho, vehammonea minalim meraglav. veyesh omrim: af mi sheen mesev bachavura shel mitzva.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi shemuel bar marta amar rav mishshum rabbi yose ish hutzal: minnayin sheen shoalin bakkaldiyyim, shenneemar: "tamim tihye im Adonai elohecha".
Uminnayin hayyodea bachavero shehu gadol mimmennu afillu bedavar echad, shechayyayv linhog bo kavod, shenneemar: "kol kovel di ruach yattira beh [umalka ashit lahakamuteh al kol malchuta]".
Vehayyoshevet al dam tahor — asura leshammesh. ad kamma? amar rav: ona.

Tanna, hu yosef ish hutzal, hu yosef habbavli, hu isi ben gur arye, hu isi ben yehuda, hu isi ben gamliel, hu isi ben mahalalel. uma shemo? — isi ben akavya shemo. hu rabbi yitzchak ben tavla, hu rabbi yitzchak ben chakla, hu rabbi yitzchak ben ila, hu

a: Rabbi yitzchak ben acha dishmata, hu rabbi yitzchak ben pinchas deaggadta. vesimanaych (shimu na achayy vereayy).

Amar rava bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mishshemeh derabbi yehuda berabbi ilay: echol batzal veshev batztzel, vela techul avozin vetarnegolin vihe libbecha rodef alecha. pechot mimmechlach umimmishteyach, vetosef al dertach.
Ki ata ulla, amar: matla matlin bemareva deachel alyeta — tashe beillita. deachel kakuli — akkikle demata shachev.
Mishna mazgu lo kos rishon. bet shammay omrim: mevarech al hayyom, veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin. uvet hillel omrim: mevarech al hayyayin, veachar kach mevarech al hayyom.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: devarim shebben bet shammay uvet hillel basseuda. bet shammay omrim: mevarech al hayyom, veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin — mippene shehayyom gorem layyayin sheyyavo, uchevar kiddesh hayyom vaadayin yayin lo ba.

Uvet hillel omrim: mevarech al hayyayin, veachar kach mevarech al hayyom — mippene shehayyayin gorem lekiddush shetteamer. davar acher: birkat hayyayin tedira uvirkat hayyom enah tedira. tadir vesheeno tadir — tadir kodem. vehilcheta kedivre bet hillel.
May davar acher? vechi tema hatam tarte vehacha chada — hacha name tarte ninhu: tadir vesheeno tadir — tadir kodem.
Vahalacha kedivre bet hillel: peshita, deha nefayk bat kol! ibbaet ema: kodem bat kol,
Vei baet ema: leachar bat kol, verabbi yehoshua hi, deamar: en mashgichin bevat kol.

Mishna heviu lefanav, metabbel bachazeret ad shemmaggia lefarperet happat. heviu lefanav matztza vachazeret vacharoset ushene tavshilin, af al pi sheen charoset mitzva. rabbi eliezer (ben) tzadok omer: mitzva. uvemikdash hayu meviin lefanav gufo shel pesach.
b: Gemara amar resh lakish: zot omeret mitzvot tzerichot kauona. kevan dela beiddan chiyyuva demaror hu deachel leh, bevore peri haadama" hu deachel leh. vedilma la ikkavvavn lemaror, hilkach bae lemehdar leatbole leshem maror. dei salka datach mitzva la baaya kauona, lema lach tere tibbule? veha tabbel leh chada zimna!
Mimmay? dilma: leolam mitzvot en tzerichot kauona, udekaamrat tere tibbule lema li? ki hechi delehve hekkera letinokot.

Vechi tema: im ken layshmeinan shear yerakot? i ashmeinan shear yerakot, hava amena: hecha deikka shear yerakot hu devaenan tere tibbule, aval chazeret lechode la bae tere tibbule, kamashma lan daafillu chazeret baenan tere tibbule, ki hechi delehve beh hekkera letinokot.
Veod tanya: achalan demay — yatza. achalan belo mitkavven — yatza. achalan lachatzain — yatza.
Uvilvad shello yishhe ben achila lachavertah yoter mikkede achilat peras!
Tannae hi. detanya, rabbi yose omer: af al pi shettibbel bachazeret — mitzva lehavi lefanav chazeret vacharoset ushene tavshilin.
Veakkatti mimmay? dilma kasavar rabbi yose mitzvot en tzerichot kavvavna, vehay devaenan tere tibbule ki hechi detihve hekkera letinokot. im ken, may "mitzva"?!
May shene tavshilin? amar rav huna: silka vearoza. rava hava meyhaddar assilka vearoza hoil venafek mippummeh derav huna.

Amar rav ashe: shema minna derav huna, let dechayesh leha derabbi yochanan ben nuri. detanya, rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: orez min dagan hu vechayyayvin al chimmutzo karet, veadam yotze bo yede chovato bappesach.
Chizkiyya amar: afillu dag uvetza shealav. rav yosef amar: tzarich shene mine vasar, echad zecher lappesach, veechad zecher lachagiga. ravina amar: afillu garma uvishshula.
Peshita, hecha deikka shear yerakot, mevarech ashshear yerakot "bore peri haadama" veachel, vahadar mevarech "al achilat maror" veachel.
Hecha delekka ella chassa, may? amar rav huna: mevarech meikkara ammaror "bore peri haadama" veachel, ulevassof mevarech aleh "al achilat maror" veachel.

a: Matkef la rav chisda: leachar shemmille kereso hemennu chozer umevarech aleh? ella amar rav chisda: meikkara mevarech aleh "bore peri haadama" veal achilat maror" veachel, ulevassof achel achilat chassa belo beracha.
Besureya avdi kerav huna, verav sheshet bereh derav yehoshua aved kerav chisda. vehilcheta kevoteh derav chisda. rav acha bereh derava mehaddar ashshear yerakot leappoke nafsheh mippelugeta.

Amar ravina: amar li rav mesharsheya bereh derav natan, hachi amar hillel mishshemeh digmara: la nichroch inish matztza umaror bahade hadade venechol, mishshum disvira lan matztza bizman hazze deorayyta, umaror derabbanan, veate maror derabbanan umevattel leh lematztza deorayyta.
Vaafillu leman deamar: mitzvot en mevattelot zo et zo, hane mille deorayyta bidorayyta o derabbanan bidrabbanan, aval deorayyta uderabbanan — ate derabbanan umevattel leh lidorayyta.
Man tanna deshamat leh mitzvot en mevattelot zo et zo? hillel hi. detanya, amru alav al hillel shehaya korchan bevat achat veochlan, shenneemar: "al matztzot umerorim yochluhu".

Amar rabbi yochanan: cholkin alav chaverav al hillel. detanya: yachol yehe korchan bevat achat veochlan kederech shehillel ochlan, talmud lomar: "al matztzot umerorim yochluhu", afillu ze bifne atzmo veze bifne atzmo. matkef la rav ashe: i hachi, may afillu?

Ella amar rav ashe, hay tanna hachi katane: yachol lo yatza behu yede chovato ella im ken korchan bevat achat veochlan kederech shehillel ochlan — talmud lomar: "al matztzot umerorim yochluhu" — afillu ze bifne atzmo veze bifne atzmo.

Hasheta dela ittemar hilcheta la kehillel vela kerabbanan, mevarech "al achilat matztza" veachel, vahadar mevarech "al achilat maror" veachel, vahadar achel matztza vechassa bahade hadade belo beracha zecher lammikdash, kehillel.
Amar rabbi elazar amar rav oshaya: kol shettibbulo bemashke — tzarich netilat yadayim. amar rav pappa: shema minna, hay chassa
b: Tzerich leshakkoeh bacharoset, mishshum kafa. dei salka datach la tzerich leshakkoeh — netilat yadayim lema li? ha la naga! vedilma leolam ema lach: la tzerich leshakkoeh, vekafa merecha mayet. ella lema li netilat yadayim — dilma meshakkeu leh.

Veamar rav pappa: la nishahe inish maror bacharoset, dilma aggav chalyeh detavlin mevattel leh limroreh, uvaenan taam maror, velekka. adbereh rav chisda lerabbana ukeva, uderash: natal yadav betibbul rishon — notel yadav betibbul shene.
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa: ha bealma ittemar. dei salka datach hacha ittemar, lema li netilat yadayim tere zimne? ha mesha leh yedeh chada zimna!
Amar lehu rav pappa: adderabba, hacha ittemar. dei salka datach bealma ittemar, lema li tere tibbule?
Ella may, hacha ittemar? netilat yadayim tere zimne lema li? ha mesha leh yedeh chada zimna! amri: kevan devae lememar aggadta vehallela, dilma assoche assecheh ledateh unega.
Amar rava: bala matztza — yatza, bala maror — lo yatza. bala matztza umaror, yede matztza — yatza, yede maror — lo yatza. kerachan besiv uvelaan — af yede matztza name lo yatza.
Amar rav shimi bar ashe: matztza lifne kol echad veechad, maror lifne kol echad veechad, vacharoset lifne kol echad veechad. veen okrin et hashshulchan ella lifne mi sheomer haggada.
Rav huna omer: kullehu name lifne mi sheomer haggada. vehilcheta kerav huna.

Lamma okrin et hashshulechan? amri deve rabbi yannay: kede sheyyakkiru tinokot veyishalu. abbaye hava yatev kammeh derabba, chaza deka madli takka mikkammeh, amar lehu: adayin la ka achlinan, atu ka meakkeri takka mikkamman?! amar leh rabba: petartan millomar "ma nishtanna".
Amar shemuel: "lechem oni" ketiv — lechem sheonin alav devarim. tanya name hachi: "lechem oni" — lechem sheonin alav devarim harebe. davar acher: "lechem oni" — "oni" ketiv, ma ani sheddarko bifrusa,

a: Af kan bifrusa. davar acher: ma darko shel ani hu massik veishto ofa, af kan name — hu massik veishto ofa.

Af al pi sheen charoset mitzva. vei la mitzva, mishshum may mayyte la? amar rabbi amme: mishshum kafa. amar rav assi: kafa dechassa — chama. kafa dechama — karate. [kafa decharate — chammime.] kafa dechullehu — chammime. addehachi vehachi, nema hachi: "kafa kafa, dechirna lach uleshav benataych uletamne kallatach".

Rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer mitzva vechulei. may mitzva? rabbi levi omer: zecher lattappuach. verabbi yochanan omer: zecher lattit. amar abbaye: hilkach tzerich lekahoyeh utzerich lesammocheh. lekahoyeh — zecher lattappuach, utzerich lesammocheh — zecher lattit.
Tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan: tavlin zecher latteven, charoset zecher lattit. amar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok, kach hayu omrim taggare charach shebbirushalayim: bou utelu lachem tavlin lemitzva.
Mishna mazgu lo kos sheni vechan habben shoel aviv. veim en daat babben aviv melammedo.

Ma nishtanna hallayla hazze mikkol hallelot. shebbechol hallelot anu ochlin chametz umatztza, hallayla hazze — kullo matztza. shebbechol hallelot anu ochlin shear yerakot, hallayla hazze — maror. shebbechol hallelot anu ochlin basar tzali shaluk umevushshal, hallayla hazze — kullo tzali. shebbechol hallelot anu matbilin paam echat, hallayla hazze — shete feamim.
Ulefi dato shel ben aviv melammedo. matchil bignut umesayyem beshevach. vedoresh mearammi oved avi", ad sheyyigmor kol happarasha kullah.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: chacham beno — shoalo. veim eno chacham — ishto shoalto, veim lav — hu shoel leatzmo, vaafillu shene talmide chachamim sheyyodin behilchot happesach — shoalin ze laze.

Ma nishtanna hallayla hazze mikkol hallelot, shebbechol hallelot anu matbilin paam echat, hallayla hazze — shete feamim. matkef la rava: attu kol yoma la saggi dela metabbela chada zimna? ella amar rava, hachi katane: shebbechol hallelot en anu chayyayvin letabbel afillu paam echat, hallayla hazze — shete feamim.
Matkef la rav safra: chiyyuva ledardeke?! ella amar rav safra, hachi katane: en anu matbilin afillu paam echat, hallayla hazze — shete feamim.
Matchil bignut umesayyem beshevach. may bignut? rav amar: "mittechilla ovde avoda zara hayu avotenu". [ushemuel] amar: "avadim hayinu".

Amar leh rav nachman ledaru avdeh: avda demappek leh mareh lecherut, veyahev leh kaspa vedahava, may bae lememar leh? amar leh: bae leodoye uleshabboche, amar leh: petartan millomar "ma nishtanna". patach veamar "avadim hayinu".
Mishna rabban gamliel haya omer: kol shello amar
b: Shelosha devarim ellu bappesach lo yatza yede chovato, veellu hen: pesach, matztza, umaror. pesach — al shum sheppasach hammakom al batte avotenu bemitzrayim, [shenneemar: "vaamartem zevach pesach hu laAdonai asher pasach vegomer"].

Matztza — al shum shennigalu avotenu mimmitzrayim, [shenneemar: "vayyofu et habbatzek asher hotziu mimmitzrayim vegomer"]. maror — al shum shemmerru hammitzriyyim et chayye avotenu bemitzrayim, shenneemar: ["vaymarru et chayyehem vegomer"].
Bechol dor vador chayyayv adam lirot et atzmo keillu hu yatza mimmitzrayim, shenneemar: "vehiggadta levincha bayyom hahu lemor baavur ze asa Adonai li betzeti mimmitzrayim".

Lefichach anachnu chayyayvim lehodot, lehallel, leshabbeach, lefaer, leromem, lehadder, levarech, lealle ulekalles lemi sheasa laavotenu velanu et kol hannissim haellu. hotzianu meavdut lecherut, miyyagon lesimcha, umeevel leyom tov, umeafela leor gadol, umishshibud ligulla. venomar lefanav haleluyah.

Ad hechan hu omer? bet shammay omrim: ad "em habbanim semecha". uvet hillel omrim: ad "challamish lemayeno mayim". vechotem bigulla. rabbi tarfon omer: asher gealanu vegaal et avotenu mimmitzrayim, velo haya chotem.

Rabbi akiva omer: "ken Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu yaggienu lemoadim velirgalim acherim habbaim likratenu leshalom, semechim bevinyan irecha, vesasim baavodatech. venochal sham (min happesachim umin hazzevachim) kulei", ad "baruch atta Adonai gaal yisrael".

Gemara amar rava: tzarich sheyyomar "veotanu hotzi mishsham". amar rava: matztza — tzarich lehagebiah, umaror — tzarich lehagebiah. basar — en tzarich lehagebiah. velo od, ella shennire keochel kadashim bachutz.
Amar rav acha bar yaakov: some patur millomar haggada. ketiv hacha: "baavur ze", uchetiv hatam: "benenu ze". ma lehallan — perat lesome, af kan — perat lesomin.

Ini? vehaamar marimar, sheeltinhu lerabbanan deve rav yosef: man deamar aggadta be rav yosef? amaru: rav yosef. man deamar aggadta be rav sheshet? amru: rav sheshet. kasavri rabbanan, matztza bizman hazze — derabbanan.
Mikkelal derav acha bar yaakov savar matztza bizman hazze deorayyta? veha rav acha bar yaakov hu deamar: matztza bizman hazze derabbanan! kasavar: kol detakkun rabbanan — keen deorayyta taykkun.
Lerav sheshet ulerav yosef name, ha vadday kol detakkun rabbanan — keen deorayyta taykkun?

Hachi hasheta?! bishlama hatam, middahava leh lemichtav "benenu hu", uchetiv "benenu ze" — shema minna: perat lesomin hu daata. aval hacha, i lav "baavur ze", may lichtov? ella baavur matztza umaror hu daata.
Lefichach anachnu chayyayvim.

a: Amar rav chisda amar rabbi yochanan: "haleluyah" vechesyah" vididya" — achat hen. rav amar: "kesyah" umerchavyah" — achat hen. rabba amar: "merchavyah" bilvad.
Ibbaya lehu: "merchav yah" lerav chisda, may? teku.
Ibbaya lehu: "yedidyah" lerav, may? ta shema, deamar rav: "yedidyah" nechlak lishnayim, lefichach: yedid chol, yah kodesh.
Ibbaya lehu: "haleluyah" lerav, may? ta shema, deamar rav: chazena tille deve chabbiva dichtiv behu "halelu" bechad gisa, veyah" bechad gisa.
Ufeliga derabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may "haleluyah"? halleluhu behillulim harebe.

Vfliga dideh addideh, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: baasara maamarot shel shevach neemar sefer tehillim: benitztzuach", beniggun", bemaskil", bemizmor", beshir", beashre", bithilla", bitfilla", behodaa", behaleluyah". gadol mikkullan "haleluyah", shekkolel shem vashevach bevat achat.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shir shebbattora, moshe veyisrael amaruhu beshaa shealu min hayyam. vehallel ze mi amaro? neviim shebbenehen tikkenu lahen leyisrael sheyyehu omrin oto al kol perek uferek, veal kol tzara vetzara shello tavo alehen. velichshennigalin, omrim oto al geullatan.
Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: kol tushebachot haamurot besefer tehillim kullan david amaran, shenneemar: "kollu tefillot david ben yishay" — al tikre "kollu", ella "kol ellu".

Hallel ze mi amaro? rabbi yose omer, elazar beni omer: moshe veyisrael amaruhu beshaa shealu min hayyam. vachalukin alav chaverav lomar sheddavid amaro. venirin devarav middivrehen. efshar yisrael shachatu et pischehen venatlu lulevehen velo amru shira?!
Davar acher: pislo shel micha omed bivchi, veyisrael omrim et hahallel?

Tanu rabbanan: kol shirot vetushebachot sheamar david besefer tehillim, rabbi eliezer omer: keneged atzmo amaran. rabbi yehoshua omer: keneged tzibbur amaran. vachachamim omrim: yesh mehen keneged tzibbur veyesh mehen keneged atzmo. haamurot bilshon yachid — keneged atzmo, haamurot bilshon rabbim — keneged tzibbur.

"Nitztzuach" veniggun" — leatid lavo. "maskil" — al yede turegman. "ledavid mizmor" — melammed sheshsharta alav shechina veachar kach amar shira. "mizmor ledavid" — melammed sheamar shira veachar kach sharta alav shechina.

Lelammedcha sheen hashshechina shora, lo mittoch atzlut velo mittoch atzvut velo mittoch sechok velo mittoch kallut rosh velo mittoch devarim betelim, ella mittoch devar simcha shel mitzva. shenneemar: "veatta kechu li menaggen vehaya kenaggen hamenaggen vattehi alav yad Adonai".
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: vechen lidvar halacha. amar rav nachman: vechen lachalom tov.

Ini?! vehaamar rav giddel amar rav: kol talmid chacham hayyoshev lifne rabbo veen siftotav notfot mar — tikkavena, shenneemar: "siftotav shoshannim notfot mor over". al tikre "shoshannim", ella "sheshshonim". al tikre "mor over", ella "mar over".
La kashya: ha — berabba, ha — betalmida.

Vei baet ema: ha veha berabba, vela kashya: ha — mikkamme defatach, veha — levatar defatach. ki ha derabba, mikkamme defatach lehu lerabbanan, amar milleta divdichuta uvadchu rabbanan, ulevassof yatev beemta, ufatach bishmata.

Tanu rabbanan: hallel ze mi amaro? rabbi eliezer omer: moshe veyisrael amaruhu beshaa sheamdu al hayyam. hem amru: "lo lanu Adonai lo lanu", meshiva ruach hakkodesh veamra lahen: "lemaani lemaani eese". rabbi yehuda omer: yehoshua veyisrael amaruhu beshaa sheamdu alehen malche chenaan. hem amru: "lo lanu", umeshiva vechulei:

Rabbi elazar hammodai omer: devora uvarak amaruhu beshaa sheamad alehem sisra. hem amru: "lo lanu", veruach hakkodesh meshiva veomeret lahem: "lemaani lemaani eese". rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: chizkiyya vesiyato amaruhu beshaa sheamad alehem sancheriv. hem amru: "lo lanu", umeshiva vechulei. rabbi akiva omer: chananya mishael vaazarya amaruhu beshaa sheamad alehem nevuchadnetztzar harasha. hem amru: "lo lanu", umeshiva vechulei. rabbi yose haggelili omer: mardechay veester amaruhu beshaa sheamad alehem haman harasha. hem amru: "lo lanu", umeshiva vechulei.
Vachachamim omrim: neviim shebbenehen tikkenu lahem leyisrael sheyyehu omrim oto al kol perek uferek veal kol tzara vetzara shello tavo alehem leyisrael. velichshennigalin, omrim oto al geullatan.

Amar rav chisda: "haleluyah" — sof pirka. rabba bar rav huna amar: "haleluyah" — resh pirka. amar rav chisda: chazena lehu letille deve rav chanin bar rav dichtiv behu "haleluyah" beemtza pirka. alma mesappeka leh.

Amar rav chanin bar rava: hakkol modim bithillat Adonai yedabber pi vivarech kol basar shem kodsho leolam vaed (haleluyah)", "haleluyah" devatreh — resh pirka. "rasha yire vechaas shinnav yacharok venamas taavat reshaim toved", "haleluyah" devatreh — resh pirka. vesheomdim bevet Adonai", "haleluyah" devatreh — resh pirka.
Karae mosifin af et ellu: "minnachal badderech yishte al ken yarim rosh", "haleluyah" devatreh — resh pirka. "reshit chochma yirat Adonai sechel tov lechol osehem", "haleluyah" devatreh — resh pirka.

Nema ketannae: ad hechan hu omer? bet shammay omrim: ad "em habbanim semecha", uvet hillel omrim: ad "challamish lemayeno mayim". vetanya iddach, ad hechan hu omer? bet shammay omrim: ad "betzet yisrael mimmitzrayim". uvet hillel omrim: ad "lo lanu Adonai lo lanu".
b: May lav, beha kamippalgi: leman deamar ad "em habbanim semecha", savar "haleluyah" — resh pirka, uman deamar ad "betzet yisrael", savar "haleluyah" — sof pirka.
Rav chisda metaretz letameh, dechulle alma savri: "haleluyah" — sof pirka. man deamar ad "betzet yisrael" shappir, uman deamar ad "em habbanim semecha", ad — vead bakkelal.
Venema ad "haleluyah"! vechi tema dela yadinan he "haleluyah" — venema "haleluyah" shel "em habbanim semecha"? kashya.
Rabba bar rav huna metaretz letameh: dechulle alma "haleluyah" — resh pirka, man deamar ad "em habbanim semecha" — shappir, uman deamar ad "betzet yisrael", savar: ad — velo ad bakkelal.
Venema: ad "haleluyah", vechi tema dela yadinan he "haleluyah" — venema ad "haleluyah" shebbetzet yisrael"? kashya.
Vechotem bigulla. amar rava: keriat shema vehallel — "gaal yisrael". ditzlota — "goel yisrael". may tama — derachame ninhu.
Amar rabbi zera: dekiddusha — "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu". ditzlota — "kaddeshenu bemitzvotecha". may tama — derachame ninhu.
Amar rav acha bar yaakov: vetzarich sheyyazkir yetziat mitzrayim bekiddush hayyom. ketiv hacha: "lemaan tizkor et yom". uchetiv hatam: "zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho".
Amar rabba bar shela: ditzlota — "matzmiach keren yeshua", deaftarta — "magen david".
"Veasiti lecha shem gadol keshem haggedolim", tane rav yosef: zehu sheomrim "magen david".
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: "veeescha legoy gadol", zehu sheomrim "elohe avraham". "vaavarechcha", zehu sheomrim "elohe yitzchak". "vaagaddela shemecha", zehu sheomrim "elohe yaakov".
Yachol yehu chotmin bechullan? talmud lomar: "vehye beracha". becha chotmin, veen chotmin bechullan.

Amar rava: ashkachtina lesave defumebdita deyatvi vekaamri: beshabbeta — ben bitzlota ben bekiddusha: "mekaddesh hashshabbat". beyoma tava — ben bitzlota uven bekiddusha: "mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim". veamena lehu ana: adderabba, ditzlota — ben beshabbeta ben beyoma tava: "mekaddesh yisrael", bekiddusha deshabbeta: "mekaddesh hashshabbat", beyoma tava: "mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim".

Vaana amena tama didi vetama didchu. tama didchu: shabbat, dikvia vekayyma — ben bitzlota uven bekiddusha: "mekaddesh hashshabbat". yoma tava, deyisrael hu dekavi leh — dekamabberi yarche vekavi leshane: "mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim".
Tama didi: tzelota, divrabbim ita: "mekaddesh yisrael". kiddush, divyachid ita, beshabbat: "mekaddesh hashshabbat", beyom tov: "mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim".
Vela hi, tzelota beyachid mi leteh? vekiddusha berabbim mi leteh? verava savar: zil batar ikkar.

Ulla bar rav nechet kammeh derava, amar kesave defumebdita, vela amar leh vela midde. alma hadar beh rava. rav natan avu derav huna bereh derav natan nechet kammeh derav pappa, amar kesave defumebdita, veshabbecheh rav pappa.

Amar ravina: ana ikkelai lesura kammeh demarimar, unechet kammeh shelucha detzibbura vaamar kesave defumebdita, vahavo meshatteki leh kulle alma, amar lehu: shivkuhu hilcheta kesave defumebdita, vela havo meshatteku leh.
Mishna mazgu lo kos shelishi mevarech al mezono. revii gomer alav et hallel, veomer alav birkat hashshir. ben hakkosot hallalu, im rotze lishtot — yishte, ben shelishi lirvii — lo yishte.
Gemara amar leh rav chanan lerava: shema minna birkat hammazon teuna kos. amar leh: arba kase tikkenu rabbanan derech cherut, kol chad vechad naaved beh mitzva.
Revii gomer alav et hahallel veomer alav birkat hashshir.

a: May "birkat hashshir"? rav yehuda amar: "yehallucha Adonai elohenu". verabbi yochanan amar: "nishmat kol chay". tanu rabbanan: revii gomer alav et hahallel, veomer hallel haggadol, divre rabbi tarfon. veyesh omrim: "Adonai roi lo echsar".

Mehechan hallel haggadol? rabbi yehuda omer: mehodu" ad "naharot bavel". verabbi yochanan omer: mishshir hammaalot" ad "naharot bavel". rav acha bar yaakov amar: mikki yaakov bachar lo yah" ad "naharot bavel".
Velamma nikra shemo hallel haggadol? amar rabbi yochanan: mippene shehakkadosh baruch hu yoshev berumo shel olam umechallek mezonot lechol beriyya.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hane esrim veshishsha "hodu", keneged mi — keneged esrim veshishsha dorot shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu beolamo velo natan lahem tora, vezan otam bechasdo.
Amar rav chisda: may dichtiv "hodu laAdonai ki tov"? hodu laAdonai sheggove chovato shel adam betovato: ashir beshoro, veet ani beseo, yatom bevetzato, almana betarnegoltah.
Amar rabbi yochanan: kashin mezonotav shel adam kiflayim kayyoleda, deillu beyoleda ketiv: "beetzev", uvimzonot ketiv "beitztzavon".
Veamar rabbi yochanan: kashin mezonotav shel adam yoter min haggeulla, deillu bigulla ketiv: "hammalach haggoel oti mikkol ra", malach bealma, veillu bimzonot ketiv: "haelohim haroe oti".

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu laadam "vekotz vedardar tatzmiach lach" zalgu enav demaot, amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, ani vachamori nochal beevus echad? kevan sheamar lo: "bezeat appecha tochal lechem", nitkarra dato.
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: ashrenu im amadnu barishona, vaadayin la paltinan minna, deka achlinan isve dedavra.
Amar rav shezvi mishshemeh derabbi elazar ben azarya: kashin mezonotav shel adam kikriat yam suf, dichtiv: "noten lechem lechol basar", usemich leh: "legozer yam suf ligzarim".
Amar rabbi elazar ben azarya: kashin nekavav shel adam keyom hammita vechikriat yam suf, shenneemar: "mihar tzoe lehippateach", uchetiv batreh: "roga hayyam vayyehemu gallav".
Veamar rav sheshet mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: kol hamevazze et hammoadot keillu oved avoda zara, shenneemar: "elohe massecha lo taase lach", uchetiv batreh: "et chag hammatztzot tishmor".

Veamar rav sheshet mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: kol hamesapper lashon hara, vechol hamekabbel lashon hara, vechol hammeid edut sheker bachavero — rauy lehashelicho lichlavim, shenneemar: "lakkelev tashlichun oto", uchetiv batreh: "lo tissa shema shav", ukeri beh: "lo tassi".
