Vechi meachar deikka hallel haggadol, anan may tama amrinan hay? mishshum sheyyesh bo chamishsha devarim hallalu: yetziat mitzrayim, keriat yam suf, umattan tora, utechiyyayt hammetim, vechevlo shel mashiach.

Yetziat mitzrayim, dichtiv: "betzet yisrael mimmitzrayim". ukeriat yam suf, dichtiv: "hayyam raa vayyanos". mattan tora, dichtiv: "heharim rakdu cheelim". techiyyayt hammetim, dichtiv: "ethallech lifne Adonai".

Chevlo shel mashiach, dichtiv: "lo lanu Adonai lo lanu", veamar rabbi yochanan: "lo lanu Adonai lo lanu" — zo shibud malchiyyot. ikka deamri, amar rabbi yochanan: "lo lanu Adonai lo lanu" — zo milchemet gog umagog.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: mippene sheyyesh bo millut nefashot shel tzaddikim miggehinnam, shenneemar: "anna Adonai malleta nafshi". chizkiyya amar: mippene sheyyesh bo yeridatan shel tzaddikim lechivshan haesh, vaaliyyaytan mimmennu.
Yeridatan, dichtiv: "lo lanu Adonai lo lanu" amar chananya, "ki leshimcha ten kavod" amar mishael, "al chasdecha veal amittecha" amar azarya, "lamma yomru haggoyim" amru kullan.

Aliyyaytan mikkivshan haesh, dichtiv: "halelu et Adonai kol goyim" amar chananya, "shabbechuhu kol haummim" amar mishael, "ki gavar alenu chasdo" amar azarya, "veemet Adonai leolam haleluyah" amru kullan.

Veyesh omrim: "veemet Adonai leolam" gavriel amaro. beshaa shehippil nimrod harasha et avraham avinu letoch kivshan haesh amar gavriel lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, ered vaatzannen veatztzil et hatztzaddik mikkivshan haesh. amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: ani yachid beolami vehu yachid beolamo, nae layyachid lehatztzil et hayyachid. ulefi shehakkadosh baruch hu eno mekappeach sechar kol beriyya, amar: tizke vetatztzil shelosha mibbene vanav.

Darash rabbi shimon hashshiloni: beshaa shehippil nevuchadnetztzar harasha chananya mishael vaazarya letoch kivshan haesh, amad yorekmo sar habbarad lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, ered vaatzannen et hakkivshan veatztzil latztzaddikim hallalu mikkivshan haesh. amar lo gavriel: en gevurato shel hakkadosh baruch hu bechach sheatta sar barad, vehakkol yodin shehammayim mechabbin et haesh. ella, ani sar shel esh ered vaakarer mibbifnim,
b: Veakdiach mibbachutz, veeese nes betoch nes. amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: red! beotah shaa patach gavriel veamar: "veemet Adonai leolam".

Rabbi natan omer: "veemet Adonai leolam" — dagim shebbayyam amaruhu, kidrav huna. deamar rav huna: yisrael shebbeoto haddor mikketanne amana hayu, vechiddaresh rabba bar mari: may dichtiv "vayyamru al yam beyam suf" — melammed shehimru yisrael beotah shaa veamru: keshem sheanu olin mitztzad echad, kach mitzriyyim olim mitztzad acher.

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lesar shel yam: pelot otan layyabbasha! amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, kelum yesh eved shennoten lo rabbo mattana vechozer venotel mimmennu? amar lo: etten lach echad umechetza shebbahen.

Amar lo: ribbono shel olam, yesh eved shettovea et rabbo? amar lo: nachal kishon yehe li arev. miyyad palat otan layyabbasha uvau yisrael verau otan. shenneemar: "vayyar yisrael et mitzrayim met al sefat hayyam".
May echad umechetza shebbahen? deillu befaro ketiv: "shesh meot rechev bachur", veillu besisra ketiv: "tesha meot rechev barzel".

Ki ata sisra [ata alayyhu bedikre defarzela, hotzi hakkadosh baruch hu alehem kochavim mimmesillotam, dichtiv:] "min shamayim nilchamu hakkochavim". kevan dinchitu kochve shamayim alayyhu, akdiru hane dikre defarzela. nechitu leakrore lemische nafshayyhu benachal kishon,

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lenachal kishon: lech vehashelem ervoncha. miyyad gerafam nachal kishon vehishlichan layyam, shenneemar: "nachal kishon gerafam nachal kedumim", may "nachal kedumim"? nachal shennaasa arev mikkedem. beotah shaa patchu dagim shel yam veamru: "veemet Adonai leolam".
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish, may dichtiv: "moshivi akeret habbayit" — amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, samuni banecha kechuleda zo haddara beikkare vattim.

Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "ahavti ki yishma Adonai" — amra keneset yisrael: ribbono shel olam emat ani ahuva lefanecha — bizman shettishma kol tachanunay. "dalloti veli yehoshia" — amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, af al pi sheddalla ani bemitzvot, lecha ani veli nae lehoshia.
Amar rav kahana: keshechala rabbi yishmael berabbi yose, shalach lo rabbi: emor lanu shenayim ushelosha devarim sheamarta lanu mishshum avicha.

Shalach lo: kach amar abba, may dichtiv: "halelu et Adonai kol goyim", ummot haolam may avidtayyhu? hachi kaamar: "hallalu et Adonai kol goyim" aggevurot veniflaot deaved bahadayyhu, kol shekken anu degavar alenu chasdo".

Veod: atida mitzrayim shettavi doron lammashiach. kesavur, eno mekabbel mehem. amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lammashiach: kabbel mehem! achsanya asu levanayy bemitzrayim. miyyad: "yeetayu chashmannim minni mitzrayim".
Nasa kush kal vachomer beatzmah: uma hallalu shennishtabedu bahen kach, ani shello nishtabadti bahen lo kol shekken. amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: kabbel mehem. miyyad "kush taritz yadav lelohim".

Nasa malchut (romi) harshaa kal vachomer beatzmah: uma hallalu sheen achehen kach, anu sheanu achehen — lo kol shekken?! amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu legavriel: "gear chayyat kane" — geor chayya ukene lecha eda.
Davar acher: "geor chayyat kane" sheddara ben hakkanim, dichtiv: "yecharsemenna chazir miyyaar veziz saday yirenna".
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: geor bechayya shekkol maaseha nichtavin bekulemos echad. "adat abbirim beegle ammim" — sheshshachatu abbirim kaagalim sheen lahem bealim.

"Mitrappes beratztze chasef" — shepposhtin yad lekabbel mamon, veen osin retzon bealim. "pizzar ammim keravot yechpatzun" — mi garam lahem leyisrael sheyyitpazzeru leven ummot haolam? kerivot shehayu chafetzin bahen.

Veod shalach lo: shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha shevavkim bichrach gadol shel romi, vechol echad veechad (hayu) [yesh] bo shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha biraniyyot, vechol biranit uviranit (hayu bo) [yesh bah] shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha maalot, vechol maala umaala (hayu bo) [yesh bah] kede lazun et kol haolam kullo.

Amar rabbi (yishmael) [shimon berabbi] lerabbi, veamri la (l)rabbi yishmael bar yose [lerabbi]: hane leman? lach ulechavrach ulechavrutach, shenneemar: "sachrah veetnannah kodesh laAdonai lo yeatzer velo yechasen ki layyoshvim lifne Adonai yihye vegomer".
